source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 1 Überschr. Τὸν ἐξ ἀγάπης κλαυθμὸν μακαριζόμενον. τοῦ γὰρ ἁγίου ἐστὶ «κλαίειν μετὰ κλαιόντων.
pass_a_gloss: The klauthmos / weeping that is from love is called blessed. For it belongs to the holy one “to weep with those who weep.”
pass_b_english: The weeping that is from love is called blessed. For it belongs to the holy one “to weep with those who weep.” (Romans 12:15)

choices.why: Origen’s continuous verb for Jeremiah’s alphabetic thrēnoi.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.

apparatus.note: Source Greek OCR-noisy; restorations for sense disclosed in translator_notes.
